mdcalc_source: https://www.mdcalc.com/calc/518/glasgow-blatchford-bleeding-score-gbs (page fetched; binary criteria/points confirmed there, but BUN/Hb/SBP band tables were not in the fetched content, so bands taken from standard published GBS (Blatchford 2000) as reproduced by WikEM/Radiopaedia)

code_vs_mdcalc.issue: Code scores on mg/dL with bands <18.2/18.2-<22.4/22.4-<28/28-70/>70 and converts mmol/L via x2.808 (urea-nitrogen MW 28.08). Equivalent to MDCalc for all values in this set. Only theoretical edge: exactly 25 mmol/L converts to 70.2 mg/dL and would score +6 in code vs +4 under the '10-25 mmol/L' band; no row has 25 mmol/L.
Hemoglobin, SBP, HR and binary criteria thresholds/points match MDCalc exactly; missing binary criteria default to absent, consistent with dataset convention.
